caseSummary: You are the Senior IR Analyst assigned to incident INC-2026-0417 at Vistara Polymers Pvt. Ltd. On 2026-09-09 at 09:47 IST, EDR alert EDR-20260909-0417 ("Suspicious PowerShell encode + external connection") fired on application server APP-PRD-01 and was surfaced by the SIEM; incident ticket INC-2026-0417 was opened and you were engaged. This dossier is your reference pack for the investigation: organization and business context, network architecture, the host and identity registries, the web/application environment, security controls, and relevant policies. All timestamps in this dossier and in Windows security-event evidence are IST (UTC+05:30); IIS artifacts are the sole exception and carry their own conversion header.

organization.name: Vistara Polymers Pvt. Ltd.
organization.industry: Specialty polymer and packaging materials manufacturing
organization.employees: ~480 (this incident concerns the Pune HQ campus and its IT estate)
organization.business: Manufactures food-grade polymer films and industrial packaging for FMCG and pharma clients. Operates one HQ campus (Pune) with a corporate office, a plant floor, and a warehouse. A second small sales office exists in Ahmedabad (no systems there are part of the HQ IT estate).
organization.profile: Mid-sized manufacturer with a small IT team, a flat network with partial segmentation, legacy systems kept alive for plant operations, and a public-facing web presence for customer orders and dealer engagement. Security maturity is moderate: an EDR rollout is in progress, a SIEM is fed by some sources, and a vulnerability scanner is in use — but gaps exist.

firewalls.FW-01: Perimeter firewall (Linux-based iptables + web UI). Default-deny inbound; rules for the three public services above. Known misconfiguration: a rule added during a 2025 vendor troubleshooting session permits TCP 3389 from any source to 203.0.113.10 (WEB-PRD-01); it was never removed (weakness W-01).
firewalls.FW-02: Internal segmentation (managed switch ACLs + host firewall policy). Separates Server VLAN from Corporate LAN and Plant VLAN. Known gap: Plant VLAN can reach FILE-PRD-01 (SMB 445) on one legacy rule for spec-sheet distribution (weakness W-06).
firewalls.dns: Internal DNS on DC-01/DC-02 (AD-integrated); external DNS hosted by ISP. DMZ hosts use ISP DNS.
firewalls.idsIps: No network IDS/IPS in line. NetFlow is collected on FW-01 but only retained 7 days and rarely reviewed (weakness W-09).

remoteAccess.vpn: VPN-GW-01: SSL-VPN for ~30 staff (sales team, plant supervisors). Authenticates against AD. No MFA (weakness W-08).
remoteAccess.rdpExposure: WEB-PRD-01 is reachable on TCP 3389 from the internet because of the FW-01 rule (weakness W-01).

policies.title: Incident Response Plan
policies.text: Defines severity levels; Sev-1 = confirmed compromise of a production server or of domain credentials. Requires: isolate affected host, disable compromised accounts, preserve evidence, notify CFO & plant head for Sev-1. Gap: policy says "isolate within 2 hours" but contains no guidance on scoping before isolation.

policies.title: Access Control & Password Policy
policies.text: 8+ characters, complexity, 90-day rotation for users; service accounts are exempt from rotation (weakness codified in policy — W-03c). Shared/service accounts must be registered in the service-account wiki.

policies.title: Change Management
policies.text: Firewall changes require a ticket plus 2 approvals. Gap: the FW-01 RDP rule (W-01) predates this policy (2025 vendor session) and was grandfathered without a ticket — the absence of a change record is discoverable in evidence.

policies.title: Backup & Recovery
policies.text: Nightly backups; RPO 24h; RTO 8h for ERP; restore tests quarterly.

policies.title: Vendor Remote Access
policies.text: Vendors must use VPN-GW-01 with named accounts; no direct RDP. Violation in practice: the 2025 vendor session that created W-01 used direct RDP for "faster troubleshooting", approved verbally by the then-IT-head (departed). Discoverable via an email artifact.

policies.title: Network Segmentation Standard
policies.text: Plant VLAN must not initiate connections to the Server VLAN. Exception: the FILE-PRD-01 SMB rule documented as "temporary" since 2024 (W-06).
